llm.summary: This skill is a Chinese-language classroom interaction coach with bounded, disclosed classroom-record use and no evidence of hidden or harmful behavior.

dimensions.detail: Reading lesson plans, class profile, student tiers, and weakness summaries is proportionate to classroom interaction coaching, and the skill instructs use of aliases/seat numbers rather than real names.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of markdown and JSON documentation/schema files; no executable files, install scripts, shell commands, package installs, or network-fetch behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some trigger phrases are broad and the skill is Chinese-language throughout, but it includes explicit routing boundaries for adjacent lesson-planning, exam-design, and student-analysis requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill writes persistent interactionLogs, but only as teacher-confirmed entries, with aggregate observations, no student names, and disclosed view, correct, delete, pause, export, and sharing controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, instructions, and references consistently support classroom questioning, group activities, cold-call avoidance, feedback, and post-class observation records.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a Chinese-medium teacher tool for classroom interaction design. Before using persistent records, confirm your classroom workspace uses aliases or seat numbers rather than real student names, and review sharing controls if records may be used by other skills or shown to parents.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only content is real, but it is coherent with the skill identity, target classroom context, examples, and China-specific safety resources; this is a localization/documentation limitation, not evidence of hidden or unsafe behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The classroom trigger phrases are broad, but the artifact also defines requests it should not handle and redirects lesson plans, exercise generation, and student analytics to other skills.
